title: XYZ workspace
description: Generated from the x-xyz-keys of the knowledge concepts by pnpm knowledge:schema. Unknown keys are allowed but undocumented.

additionalProperties.description: A template; its content is a partial layer

ScaleLine.description: Units of the scale bar; any value other than imperial shows metric.

title.description: Dialog title; the consent_title dictionary entry by default.

consent.description: Asks a logged in user once for consent and stores the answer with the user.

mask.description: Grey out the map outside the extent.

css.description: Inline style of the popup content.

features.description: List the cluster label of each clustered feature instead of their number.

feature_info.description: A button which shows the properties of a clicked feature in a popup.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per search.

layer_order.description: Layer keys in draw order; layers not listed are drawn on top.

icon_name.description: Name of a Material Symbols icon.
Name of a Material Symbols icon.

link_button.description: A link button in the map button column, or an array of them.

items.description: An Openlayers control class created without options; unknown names are ignored.

srid.description: EPSG code of the mapview projection, digits only.

additionalProperties.description: URL or data URI of an SVG template.

userIDB.description: A developer button which edits the user record in the browser's IndexedDB.

maxZoom.description: Maximum zoom of the view; takes precedence over locale.maxZoom.

minZoom.description: Minimum zoom of the view; takes precedence over locale.minZoom.

view.description: The start view, passed to the Openlayers View; other ol.View options apply.

URI.description: Tile URL template, eg. with {z}/{x}/{y}; layer.params are appended as query string.

accessToken.description: Mapbox access token; maplibre only fetches style.URL when it is set.

cacheSize.description: Number of tiles the MVT render source caches; 0 disables the cache.

distance.description: Browser clustering distance in pixels; below 1 the cluster configuration is removed. Excludes resolution.

hexgrid.description: Clusters on a hexagon grid with the cluster_hex template.

resolution.description: Database cluster grid size as a fraction of the tile width at the current zoom; must be greater than 0. Excludes distance.

featureFormat.description: The mapp.layer.featureFormats method which parses the response or inline features; defaults to format. Plugins add values to the registry; see plugin-extensions.md.

featureLookup.description: Objects whose ID property matches a feature ID; only matched features display, with the object's properties.

featureLookupId.description: Property of the featureLookup objects which holds the feature ID.

featureSet.description: Feature IDs to display; other features are not styled. An empty array displays all.

features.description: Inline features, parsed with layer.featureFormat. A layer with features requests no data.

exclude.description: Entry fields never listed in the panel, even with an entry filter.

include.description: Entry fields listed in the panel although their entry has no filter.

format.description: Selects the method of mapp.layer.formats which creates the OpenLayers layer. Plugins add values to the registry; see plugin-extensions.md.

groupClassList.description: CSS classes added to the group drawer; only the layer which creates the group applies them.

mvt_cache.description: Ignored with a warning; MVT tile caching is disabled.

layer_template.description: Workspace template key which the XYZ API uses as the layer for this layer's queries.

z.description: Sends the current map zoom as the z param.

params.description: Request params of every layer data query; custom query templates may read further params.

qID.description: Unique ID column of the layer table.

source.description: Name of the Openlayers tile source class

srid.description: EPSG code of the geometry column. Write it as a string; mvt only accepts "3857" or no srid.

URL.description: Mapbox GL style URL. maplibre only fetches it with layer.accessToken; otherwise it needs layer.style.object.

cache.description: Reuse the style computed for each feature.

logScale.description: Grow cluster icons with the natural log of the cluster size.

contextFilter.description: CSS filter applied to the tile canvas

drawer.description: false shows the panel without an expandable drawer.

elements.description: Order of the style panel elements.

hidden.description: Do not create the style panel.
Do not show the hover controls in the style panel.

field.description: Numeric feature property which scales the icon.

additionalProperties.description: Assigned to icon_scaling when selected; may also set scaleFactor

fields.description: Named fields offered in a style panel dropdown.

hidden.description: Do not show icon scaling controls in the style panel.
Do not show the label controls in the style panel.

object.description: An inline Mapbox GL style document, used by maplibre when style.URL is not fetched.

opacitySlider.description: Adds an opacity slider to the style panel.

tables.description: Tables by integer zoom level; null hides the layer at those levels.

anchor.description: Icon anchor as [x, y] fractions of the icon size.

color.description: Marker colour of the markerLetter symbol.

colorDot.description: Dot colour of the markerColor symbol.

colorMarker.description: Marker colour of the markerColor symbol.

layers.description: Inner rings of the dot-like symbols

strokeColor.description: Ring colour of the circle symbol.

strokeWidth.description: Ring width of the circle symbol.

substitute.description: Map of strings in the SVG template to their replacements.

template.description: Key of a locale.svgTemplates entry drawn by the template type.

type.description: The mapp.utils.svgSymbols method drawn when the icon has no url. Plugins add values to the registry; see plugin-extensions.md.

url.description: Image or SVG URL; takes precedence over type.

lineDash.description: Line and gap lengths in pixels, eg. [5, 4].

zIndex.description: Draw order within the layer; the highlight style defaults to Infinity.

icon.description: Shorthand for style.icon; the parser moves it into the category style.

distribution.description: Compute the legend from the loaded features; count shows present values with counts, jenks sets natural breaks. A method of mapp.layer.featureFields.distribution; plugins add values to it; see plugin-extensions.md.

field.description: The feature property which selects the category; distributed themes default to id.

fields.description: Feature properties of a categorized icon theme; each category names its field.

graduated_breaks.description: Whether a graduated category value is the upper (less_than) or lower (greater_than) bound; other values become less_than.

label.description: The legend label beside the symbol of a basic theme.

classList.description: Set by the ui from layout and nowrap; a configured value is replaced.

showEmptyCat.description: Show categories without features in a count distribution legend.

legend.description: Legend layout; a jenks distribution also passes it to formatNumericValue, eg. prefix, suffix and round for the category labels.

type.description: The theme method of mapp.layer.themes; a theme with an unknown or missing type is ignored with a warning. Plugins add values to the registry; see plugin-extensions.md.

disableTabClose.description: The tab of a tab or dataview entry has no close button and no middle click close.

disabled.description: The tab of a tab or dataview entry is dimmed and inert; the display toggle of a layer entry is disabled.

dynamic.description: A dataview or tab entry is recreated and updated each time its tab is shown.

distinct.description: Not read. in and ni filters query distinct values whenever they have no value array.

dropdown.description: in and ni filters show a dropdown instead of checkboxes.

dropdown_pills.description: A dropdown which shows the selected values as pills.

dropdown_search.description: A dropdown with a search input.

field.description: Column to filter; defaults to entry.field.

histogram.description: Shows a histogram dataview above a numeric range; an object is merged into the dataview configuration.

in.description: Values offered by an in filter instead of the distinct values of the field.

label.description: Checkbox label of boolean and null filters.

label_a.description: Label of the lower range input.

label_b.description: Label of the upper range input.

leading_wildcard.description: A like filter matches anywhere in the value

max.description: Fixed upper bound of a numeric or integer range; queried from the field when unset.

meta.description: Text shown at the top of the filter card.

min.description: Fixed lower bound of a numeric or integer range; queried from the field when unset.

ni.description: Values offered by a ni filter instead of the distinct values of the field.

prefix.description: Unit shown in the range labels.

searchbox.description: in and ni filters show a searchbox which adds values as pills.

suffix.description: Unit shown in the range labels when there is no prefix.

type.description: The mapp.ui.layers.filters method of the panel and the filter expression type it writes. Plugins add values to the registry; see plugin-extensions.md.

filter.description: true derives the filter type from entry.type, a string is a filter type, false never lists the entry.

hideTabClose.description: The tab of a tab or dataview entry has no close button.

max.description: Upper bound of numeric and integer entries

min.description: Lower bound of numeric and integer entries

step.description: Step of the range filter of numeric and integer entries; editing uses edit.step.

type.description: The entry method of the ui entries registry. Aliases datetime, html, integer, image, images, documents and report; mvt_clone and vector_layer are deprecated for layer, defaults does nothing. Plugins add values to the registry; see plugin-extensions.md.

in.description: Values to match; a single value is wrapped in an array.

ni.description: Values to match; a single value is wrapped in an array.
